description: This file defines the API interfaces for a LogAgent component in the COSA Data Model, including functions to get and set parameters, commit changes, and validate or rollback configuration. It provides function prototypes primarily related to log agent parameter manipulation, associated with a specific plugin object.

methods.name: LogAgent_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG value of a specified parameter for the LogAgent.

methods.name: LogAgent_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG value for a specified parameter of the LogAgent.

methods.name: LogAgent_Commit
methods.description: Commits the current configuration changes for the LogAgent.

methods.name: LogAgent_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for the LogAgent.

methods.name: LogAgent_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for the LogAgent.

methods.name: LogAgent_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the LogAgent.

methods.name: LogAgent_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the LogAgent.
